settings.business_note: Changing the business name and year from the app is coming later.

settings.mode_cash_hint: Simple. What is in my pocket.
settings.mode_accrual_hint: What I earned, paid or not.
settings.mode_needs_internet: Switching needs internet. Try again when you are online.
settings.mode_note: You can switch back any time. Nothing is lost.
settings.default_fee_hint: Filled in when you pick this wallet. You can change it each time.
settings.hide_account_hint: Not shown when paying. Balance stays in the books.
settings.account_need_name: Give the account a name or pick a provider.
settings.accounts_hint: Cash in hand is where sales land unless you pick another. Add a wallet for each one you use.
settings.tax_hint: Only if you are registered. Adds a 5% tax option to each sale.
settings.display_note: These settings are kept on this phone.
